I gave GPT-6 Astra eight hours to research, build, and backtest trading strategies. In this full guide, I’ll show you the tools, prompts, and TradingView setup so you can follow the process yourself.

But impressive backtests are only part of the story. GPT-6 stopped working partway through the experiment—and its final arena ranking revealed something the biggest profit figures didn’t tell us.

We’ll connect ChatGPT to a backtesting engine, inspect the strategies it produces, and walk through the TradingView alerts and broker connection used to automate execution.

Watch through the final leaderboard to see how GPT-6 compares with Claude Fable 5.1 and Grok Bot—and why drawdown and forward testing matter alongside returns.

💬 COMMENT “GPT6” and tell me: which matters most to you—return, drawdown, or performance on new market data?

✅ How to connect GPT-6 to Trader.dev through an MCP server
